sentences.en: The boat was tied to the shore by a cable.
sentences.zh: 这艘船用缆绳系在岸边。

sentences.en: They're working hard to get the cable laid in time.
sentences.zh: 他们正努力确保电缆能按时铺设好。

sentences.en: Next week, the electrician will come and fix the cable.
sentences.zh: 下周电工会来修理电线。

senses.zh: 打海底电报；把...拧成缆；用缆捆住
